core_scorer.fold_group_key: core source_unit_id; no source unit crosses folds
core_scorer.feature_definition: normalized query-candidate word/character TF-IDF, reciprocal-rank fusion, routing-view and attribution-vote scores, plus training-fold profile coordinates computed from text after removal of construction labels and explicit helpful/risky cue fields

implementation_provenance.boundary: The reviewer artifact reproduces every reported metric from fixed per-query ranks and exposes the scorer protocol. End-to-end retraining and query-refresh scripts remain internal provenance because the reference is a benchmark probe, not a deployable method claim.
